Subject: Re: Onboarding walkthrough — few logistics questions

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for offering the console walkthrough. A couple of quick logistics items from our side:

- We have 2 engineering pods joining from UK (BST) and one from Austin (CDT). Several folks will be in meetings until 10:30am PT and may join ~+30 minutes late.
- Can you confirm whether you record the session and if recordings are split by segment (console demo vs. API hands-on) so folks can jump to the relevant part?
- Any recommendation for how to handle attendees who only want the API portion vs. the console portion?

Also, we need a preflight checklist for SSO roles and sandbox creds so the late joiners can jump straight into the hands-on labs.

Maya will be sending the final attendee list later today.

Appreciate any suggestions on how to structure the hour to minimize churn.

—Alex

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered participation + recording segmentation for FinBridge console walkthrough

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. Good questions — we can make this low-friction. Proposed approach below:

1) Split the 90-minute session into two labeled segments (we'll send a timestamped recording):
   - Segment A (30m): Console walkthrough + admin controls (10:00–10:30 PT)
   - Segment B (45m): API enablement + hands-on lab (10:30–11:15 PT)
   - Q&A / wrap (15m) and optional breakout lab for late joiners (11:15–11:30 PT)

2) Recording: we will record and upload two assets: a trimmed video of Segment A and a separate trimmed video for Segment B plus the raw recording. That way engineers can jump directly to the API portion.

3) Late-join policy: any attendee can join mid-session; for hands-on lab entry we recommend they land in our breakout lab (we'll keep an open lab for +30/+45 minute arrivals). Ben (copied) and I will shepherd the lab and Tessa will act as backup facilitator to accept late entrants and verify sandbox creds.

4) Preflight checklist (please confirm the list of attendees + SSO roles):
   - Add attendees to FinBridge SSO group 'redwood-onboard-guest' at least 48 hours prior
   - Share sandbox API keys (read/write) via secure Drive link or your secrets manager
   - Confirm access to the test dataset: account id and dataset name

I've attached an onboarding runbook and a draft agenda. If this looks good I'll send a calendar invite for 2027-05-11 10:00 PT and include clear segment markers in the invite description.

Does that solve the main concerns? If yes, I'll lock the invite and include an explicit note for late joiners so they know exactly where to jump in.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

- We can run the breakout lab as a rolling open lab. I'll provision a second sandbox host at +15 mins if the first group hits quota.
- We'll post a single-line "jump to API" timestamp in the calendar event and in the chat during the session.
- Tessa — can you be the lab greeter and accept late SSO joins? I'll handle the environment scale if we get more than 5 simultaneous lab users.

On SSO: if Maya can give us the SSO group membership list by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-05) we can run a quick preflight and avoid delays.

—Ben
